campaign: Gate 4: self-selected CMFGEN-based mdot and sonic-point wind (Report 23)
registration: Pre-registered before any result it governs. When written, no hydro step had been evaluated on any CMFGEN state and the spectral/native g_rad audit had not been run. Definitions below were informed only by source code (cmfgen_backend.py, hydro_terms_v5.f, cmfgen_sub.f) and by the Gate-4 survey of non-converged iterates, which is not evidence.

references.sander2017: src/qstars/data/sources.json (audited_not_replicated); hydrodynamically consistent PoWR iteration, inner optical depth as a matching constraint

equations.continuity: mdot = 4 pi r^2 rho v, constant
equations.momentum: (v^2 - a^2) dlnv/dlnr = N, N = 2 a^2 - d a^2/dlnr - G M (1 - Gamma)/r
equations.sound_speed: a^2 = P_gas/rho = (n_nuclei + n_e) k T / rho_clump from the CMFGEN populations (RVTJ Atom Density, Electron density, Temperature, Mass Density). Isothermal-type: T is a frozen function of the coordinate, NOT the adiabatic speed of material_wind.continuum_coefficients
equations.radiative_force: Gamma = r^2 g_rad/(G M), g_rad = SpectralSnapshot.moments(coherent_scattering=True)['radiative_acceleration'] (local comoving force over mean density)
equations.optical_depth: dtau_R/dr = -kappa_R rho, kappa_R = chi_Rosseland/rho_clump from RVTJ; tau_R of the state integrated independently (trapezoid in ln r of chi_R f r, outer power-law tail tau = chi r/(p-1))
equations.critical_point: v_c = a_c and N(r_c) = 0; branch slope from spherical_wind.regular_sonic_slope in (ln r, ln v, ln tau) with dlnTau/dlnr supplied; unique positive slope with D increasing outward required

frozen_representations.tau: PRIMARY. a^2, Gamma and kappa_R frozen as functions of ln tau_R; r da^2/dr = (da^2/dlntau)(dlntau/dlnr) depends on mdot and v
frozen_representations.radius: CROSS-CHECK and existence proof. a^2, Gamma, kappa_R frozen as functions of ln r; N is then independent of v and mdot, every critical point is enumerated by sign changes of N on the whole domain, and mdot follows linearly from the base optical depth

equations.interpolation: Monotone PCHIP of ln a^2, Gamma and ln kappa_R on the frozen coordinate. Evaluation outside the table raises; no extrapolation and no clipping. A trial that leaves the table is a rejected local trial, never a physical result

constraints: regular accelerating critical crossing (fixes the ln v constant)
outer: tau_R(r_o) = tau_o at the outer condition depth
base: tau_R(R_b) = tau_b (primary) or rho(R_b) = rho_b (rematch cross-check)
unknowns_and_constraints.count: 3 unknowns, 3 constraints; sonic radius and mdot are outputs; no velocity or mdot input
unknowns_and_constraints.not_constrained_here: Material first law and population/transfer response are not solved by the hydro step; they are imposed by re-converging the CMFGEN T-released closure on the new flow (outer fixed point)

mass.provenance: CMFGEN component input VADAT [MASS] (backends/cmfgen/prepare_cool.py), declared explicitly to every call; not physically sourced. mdot is exponentially sensitive to it

inputs.luminosity: comoving luminosity of the converged state at the base depth (moments luminosity_comoving); used for the photon-tiring classification and the MLT guard flux
inputs.base_radius_and_tau: R_b and tau_b of the converged first closure at 1-based depth ND-2, held fixed for the whole outer iteration; later to be supplied by the QStarS envelope (Gate 5)
inputs.outer_radius_and_tau: r_o and tau_o at 1-based depth 2 of the same state, held fixed
inputs.table_depths: 1-based depths 1..ND-1. Depth ND (diffusion inner boundary) is excluded from source tables; depths 1 and ND-1 are interpolation margins only
inputs.composition: H/He from the CMFGEN state (H/He = 9.3333 by number, X = 0.7015); the Mach-one guard EOS/opacity must use the same X within 1e-4
inputs.density_convention: mean density rho = rho_clump f; f = 1 in all current T9 states
inputs.forbidden: VTURB (line width), the prescribed beta-law, a fitted or tuned force multiplier, any density/temperature floor

classification_order.name: reduction_invalid
classification_order.when: input checks fail: |v|/c >= 0.01 anywhere, spectral/RVTJ material state differ by more than 1e-3, guard composition mismatch

classification_order.name: mach_one_mlt_exit
classification_order.when: existing Mach-one MLT guard trips (convective Mach >= 1) at any subsonic CMFGEN depth with tau_R >= 2/3, for either guard opacity
classification_order.semantics: structured domain exit, never clipped, never a pass (docs/validity.md:105-111)

classification_order.name: reduction_invalid
classification_order.when: guard Mach < 1 everywhere but MLT would carry more than 1% of the flux at a guarded depth (CMFGEN carries no convective flux)

classification_order.name: reduction_invalid
classification_order.when: radius mode: N(R_b) >= 0 (no accelerating subsonic base), or N changes sign but no admissible X-type crossing, or N touches zero without a sign change (|max N| r/(G M) <= 1e-6)

classification_order.name: hydrostatic_no_wind
classification_order.when: radius mode: N r/(G M) < -1e-6 at every point of the whole base-to-outer domain (32 samples per table interval). Every regular stationary solution is then subsonic and accelerating and mdot < mdot_bound = 4 pi r_o^2 P_hs(r_o)/a(r_o), P_hs the frozen-source hydrostatic pressure normalized by the same base condition
classification_order.note: scoped to that frozen state; must be confirmed on a re-converged structure before being reported as an outcome

classification_order.name: multiple_admissible_branches
classification_order.when: radius mode has more than one admissible X-type crossing

classification_order.name: numerical_failure
classification_order.when: radius- or tau-mode integration failure, nonconvergent tau-mode root, exhausted evaluation or outer-iteration budget

classification_order.name: photon_tiring_exit
classification_order.when: mdot G M/(R_b L) >= 1 for the tau-mode mdot

classification_order.name: reduction_invalid
classification_order.when: a screen at the tau-mode critical point fails (thermal relaxation, photon trapping, nonrelativistic profile, shell-mass fraction, GENCOOL channel closure)

classification_order.name: stationary_transonic_wind
classification_order.note: component result only; certification requires the outer fixed point and every acceptance threshold

acceptance_thresholds.inherited: benchmarks/cmfgen_validation_plan.json and benchmarks/cmfgen_cool_validation_plan.json thresholds apply unchanged at every accepted closure (electron balance 1%, global/cumulative radiation energy 0.1%, last native correction 0.1% all levels, populations/charge 1e-6, spectral material temperature 0.1%, internal profile refinement 1%)

definitions.momentum_residual_relative: |v dv/dr + rho^-1 dP_gas/dr + G M/r^2 - g_rad| / (|v dv/dr| + |rho^-1 dP_gas/dr| + G M/r^2 + |g_rad|); v dv/dr = v^2 (sigma+1)/r from the CMFGEN velocity law, dlnP/dlnr from PCHIP in ln r; native HYDRO % error reported alongside
definitions.spectral_vs_native_grad: native g_RAD uses the inner comoving luminosity L(ND) (hydro_terms_v5.f:214), the export uses local force; compare g_spec with g_RAD L_comoving(r)/L_comoving(r_ND). The raw ratio is reported but is a definitional difference, not an error
definitions.thermal_relaxation_time: (translational + resolved atomic energy density from hhe_material) / (0.5 sum over GENCOOL channel rows of |rate|); per-channel nets underestimate gross exchange, so the screen is conservative. Translational-only energy is a lower bound and does not pass the screen
definitions.flow_time: H_rho/v_c with H_rho = r_c/|2 + s_c|, s_c the critical slope
definitions.base_rematch: move the base to another subsonic depth with tau_b (or rho_b) read from the solution; recovered mdot
definitions.resolution_threshold_basis: Existing completion_gates.json 'spherical wind component profile refinement' (1e-3 max |dlog|) applied unchanged to ln mdot, ln r_s and the wind v, rho profiles at shared radii
definitions.gencool_channel_closure_relative: |sum of GENCOOL channel rows - native net| / sum |rows|; rows with 'Ratio of' or 'Net Cooling' are not channels

outer_fixed_point_policy.variable: x = ln mdot of the flow written to the CMFGEN closure; G_k = xhat_k - x_k with xhat_k from the tau-mode hydro step on converged closure k
outer_fixed_point_policy.closure_settings: nk167_hot settings at the time of the first converged closure (PTC, --split, approved ultra weight, convergence 1e-3); recorded per iterate, never changed mid-iteration
outer_fixed_point_policy.later_steps: secant x_{k+1} = x_k - G_k (x_k - x_{k-1})/(G_k - G_{k-1}) if G_k != G_{k-1} and the secant point lies inside the latest sign-change bracket when one exists; otherwise x_{k+1} = x_k + 0.5 G_k
outer_fixed_point_policy.trust_region: |x_{k+1} - x_k| <= ln 10; a truncated step is recorded as truncated, never silent
outer_fixed_point_policy.flow_written: hydro-step velocity law vhat_k(r) on the regenerated radius grid with mdot = exp(x_{k+1}); density from continuity; RVSIG_COL sigma = dlnv/dlnr - 1; VTURB unchanged
outer_fixed_point_policy.converged_when: |G_k| <= 3e-4 and |ln rhat_s,k - ln r_s,k| <= 3e-4 and closure-k momentum residual passes
outer_fixed_point_policy.budget: 12 outer iterations; exhaustion is numerical_failure (not a physical statement)
outer_fixed_point_policy.preservation: every closure, hydro step, trial and rejected iterate is kept

repeat_criteria.restart: outer fixed point repeated from 3 x and 1/3 x the converged mdot
repeat_criteria.base_rematch: hydro step on the converged closure with the base moved to two other subsonic depths
repeat_criteria.resolution: final structure re-converged at 333 radii (nested transfer) and with doubled frequency; one hydro step each, no further outer iteration
repeat_criteria.numerical: hydro step repeated with rtol/10 and tables oversampled; profile refinement threshold above
repeat_criteria.guard: Mach-one MLT guard with Henyey alpha=2 and ML1 alpha=2 (existing guard models)

pending_user_approval.item: Mach-one guard opacity on non-LTE CMFGEN structure
pending_user_approval.proposal: evaluate with both CMFGEN Rosseland mean and MESA LTE opacity and trip if either trips
pending_user_approval.why_pending: The existing guard (atmosphere_reference.py:78-93) uses MESA LTE opacity with FreeEOS on LTE structures; applying it to a non-LTE structure is a new application of an existing gate. Default applied meanwhile: 'both' (cannot weaken the guard)

pending_user_approval.item: relaxing the resolution criterion on ln mdot from 1e-3 to the CMFGEN internal-profile 1%
pending_user_approval.proposal: not applied; recorded only so that any later relaxation is visibly a user decision
pending_user_approval.why_pending: would change how the existing spherical-wind profile refinement gate is applied

pending_user_approval.item: thermal-relaxation screen: wording and gross-exchange estimate (amendment 2026-10-07T04:25Z)
pending_user_approval.proposal: (a) acceptance_thresholds.definitions.thermal_relaxation_time is a gross-exchange PROXY, not a conservative bound: the relaxation rate that matters, T dLambda_net/dT, can be well below the per-process gross exchange, so 'the screen is conservative' is withdrawn. (b) Drop the two GENCOOL 'Adiabatic cooling rate' rows (V term, dTdR term; flow work present under INC_AD T, verified on results/nk167_hot/it26_trial_l1/GENCOOL) from the gross-exchange estimate; they stay in the gencool_channel_closure_relative sum
pending_user_approval.why_pending: (b) changes a pre-registered definition, and the adiabatic rows shorten t_th and so bias t_th/t_flow toward passing. Default applied meanwhile: the screen must pass with BOTH the registered all-channel estimate and the radiative-only one (stricter; cannot weaken the screen). No threshold value changes

pending_user_approval.proposal: a transonic step is a nonconvergent root (rule 7) when |base_log_residual| > hydro_step_base_condition_log_residual (1e-8), when the tau-mode outer residual |ln tau(r_o) - ln tau_o| exceeds the same 1e-8, or when regularity_relative > critical_regularity_relative (1e-6); a 'passed' Mach-one guard counts only if it guarded at least one depth (tau_R >= 2/3, subsonic) with both opacities, otherwise rule 1
pending_user_approval.why_pending: the base and regularity thresholds were declared but not enforced by classify; applying the base-condition tolerance to the outer condition, and refusing a vacuous guard pass, are stricter applications of rules 1 and 7. Default applied meanwhile: enforced (cannot weaken any gate). Requiring both guard opacities only enforces the default already declared above

not_in_scope: Coupled characteristic analysis when the isothermal-type reduction fails its screens (docs/nlte_backend.md:93 then applies)
Convective handoff to the QStarS envelope and physically sourced base data (Gate 5)
Non-nested state transfer and the restart writer for a new radius/velocity grid
Opening cmfgen_backend.production_outer or a winds.rate 'cmfgen_selected' mode before every criterion passes
classification_rule: First matching rule in classification_order; all diagnostics are reported regardless

amendments.before_any_governed_result: no converged T-released closure exists and no hydro step has been evaluated on one; Reports/evidence/report23/grad_input_audit.json (an input audit on archived non-converged states) cites the previous sha
changes: Two pending_user_approval items added (thermal screen; rule-7/guard enforcement), each with a non-weakening default

Implementation, no gate change: tau mode solves (ln mdot, ln(tau_c - tau_o)) with mdot only in logs, so tau_c - tau_o << tau_o and mdot below the float range are resolved (tests at R_b = r_c/40 and r_c/7000 against the radius mode and an independent Parker quadrature); the Newton stop uses the reported ln-tau/outer forms

Implementation, no gate change: a radius-mode critical-point candidate whose branch stalls at |v^2/a^2 - 1| < 1e-3 (the D -> 0, N != 0 fold; the only singularity of the step's ODE) is a rejected crossing, as a sonic re-encounter already was; any other integration failure leaves the candidate unresolved and the whole step numerical_failure (rule 7) after the enumeration completes

Implementation, no gate change: outer_fixed_point_policy.converged_when is enforced in full (|G_k|, |d ln r_s| and the closure momentum criterion); mdot and r_s at the fixed point with the momentum criterion failing is reported as not converged
Implementation, no gate change: rule-9 screens read the state at the step's own critical point (ln tau_R = ln tau_c in tau mode, ln r = ln r_c in radius mode) and raise outside the state table
